caption: The drawing depicts a single rectangular table with four cabriole legs, shown in a three-quarter view. The table has a wooden frame with a reddish-brown hue, and the visible surfaces of the wood are rendered with highlights and shadows to suggest curvature and dimensionality. The tabletop appears to be made of light-colored marble or a similar material, indicated by cream and pale grey tones with faint marbling patterns. The table is positioned such that its shadow, shaded in grey, extends behind and to the left side of the table on the flat ground. The entire scene is enclosed within a single-line rectangular border set slightly within the edge of the paper, and the background is plain and off-white.
title: Marble Top Table
